subtitle.viltrumitecore.city.alarm.warni: Meteor warning for the city! Move away from windows and get ready to take shelter.
Air raid warning! An unknown portal is opening over the city. Head for the shelters.
Attention! A threat to the city. Stay calm and follow the way to the shelters.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.city.alarm.activ: State of emergency! Meteors are hitting the city. Get inside, stay low, keep away from glass.
State of emergency! The city is under attack. Stay indoors and keep off the streets.
State of emergency declared. Take shelter in the nearest building.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.city.alarm.criti: Critical situation! The power grid is failing district after district. Everyone to the shelters, now!
subtitle.viltrumitecore.city.alarm.all_c: All clear. The danger is over; power is being restored district by district.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.city.cascade: Cascade failure at the %s substation: outages are spreading.
